Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer. Finding the right slice of your work — filtered, sorted, and grouped just the way you like it — used to mean rebuilding the same setup over and over. Not anymore. Saved Views lets you capture any combination of filters, sorting, and grouping as a reusable view you can return to in one click.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so there's nothing extra to buy. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, deadline, or whatever structure fits your workflow. Need your team on the same page? Views can be shared with a team, so everyone sees the same filtered lists without recreating them from scratch.

Whether you're tracking sprint progress, monitoring overdue tasks, or building a dashboard for a client review, Saved Views keeps your workspace organized and consistent across your whole team.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
